cues: Cartilage versus bone: matrix, cells, canaliculi, blood supply and covering.
That missing blood supply is why a torn knee cartilage heals so much more slowly than a broken bone.
And one more favourite: frog bone has no Haversian systems.
Those are a feature of mammals.
